name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 5 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 14 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 5 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.22 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
